heading: Engineer, occasional writer, reluctant on-call person.

photo.alt: Portrait of Rohan by a window

bio: I am a full-stack engineer based in Bengaluru. For the last eight years I have worked on products where the database is the hard part: freight dispatch, payment reconciliation and offline-first mobile apps.
I care about boring, observable systems. Most of my best work has been removing things: a queue nobody needed, a cache that hid a slow query, a deploy step that only one person understood.
Outside work I write about what breaks in production and how we fixed it. Some of those notes are on the [blog](/blog).
